issue_context.title: CLN: remove PY2
issue_context.body:
master issue for removing all vestigaes of Python 2.

After merging: #24942 (removing the PY2 CI jobs) and #25554 (bump numpy to 1.13.3), we will be ready to remove PY2 code, tests, and doc references.

Let's do this in bite sized pieces. IOW don't do a PR with changes for everything.

cc @pandas-dev/pandas-core
comments: Have we discussed whether we continue to support 3.5? Matplotlib master seems to be on 3.6.

I think it would be great to jump to 3.6 eventually for better typing support, f-strings, dict ordering, etc... but at the same time I think it makes sense to rip out the Py27 chunks first before going that route, as there will be plenty as is to clean up
step by step here. Let's remove PY2 first. Agree not against dropping 3.5 but should not do all at once.

CF seems to have deprecated 3.5 building?
http://conda-forge.org/docs/user/introduction.html#pinned-announcements

Anaconda has stopped building 3.5 packages.

On Thu, Mar 14, 2019 at 10:30 AM William Ayd <notifications@github.com>
wrote:

> I think it would be great to jump to 3.6 eventually for better typing
> support, f-strings, dict ordering, etc... but at the same time I think it
> makes sense to rip out the Py27 chunks first before going that route, as
> there will be plenty as is to clean up
>
> —
> You are receiving this because you are on a team that was mentioned.
> Reply to this email directly, view it on GitHub
> <https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/25725#issuecomment-472919940>,
> or mute the thread
> <https://github.com/notifications/unsubscribe-auth/ABQHIiP4yYwqpjHFLSANkOOFUXYO5vgXks5vWmsagaJpZM4b0Bb6>
> .
>
That's actually affecting @h-vetinari's other PR; pytest wasn't being bumped correctly on the 3.5 build (since Anaconda doesn't have new enough 3.5 packages for it).

ok merged the removal of the CI jobs for PY2: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/24942

open season on PY2 removals. but let's do this in a measured way.

cc @pandas-dev/pandas-core

Before it's open season, I'd suggest to at least merge #25752 first - currently the CI is much reduced from what it was due to the requested hard deletion of PY2-jobs in #24942 (instead of replacing them with new CI jobs).

Another possible candidate to wait for is #25554 (which depends on #25752 in some sense).

After #26047 is merged the `pandas.compat` related code removals should be complete, but there are still a few odds and ends left:
- `pandas.compat` can still be cleaned up a bit, and some items can be moved elsewhere
- There are a few explicit TODO(PY2) or TODO(py27) comments that should be addressed, e.g.
  https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/19626d2567487f8e698174de835c28c900784ed3/pandas/core/arrays/categorical.py#L1511
- There looks to be one import of `six` still around that can be removed:
  - After removing it do we also want to remove `LICENSES/SIX`?
 https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/19626d2567487f8e698174de835c28c900784ed3/scripts/merge-pr.py#L33
- @jreback mentioned that `UserDict` can also be changed in https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/25957#discussion_r271257819
   - Not exactly sure what this entails though
- Additional Cython modifications?
  - Not well versed enough in that part of the codebase to say if we've addressed everything there
- There are various comments referring to Python 2 that we can edit/address
  - I doubt all of them are actionable, and some probably just need to be deleted

I don't think we necessarily need to completely resolve every item in the list above before closing this issue, e.g. addressing all the Python 2 comments could probably be done on an "as we see it" basis.  I might also be forgetting something, so feel free to add to the list.

do we have anything left of this? 

cc @pandas-dev/pandas-core
@topper-123 went berserk on this issue, so probably he's a good one to judge this 🙂

1. ``pandas.core.base.StringMixin`` is still there, I've given up on removing that one. If someone could take a look?
2. There's some remaining functions in ``pandas.compat``. Some of these are not really compat functions and should be moved to other locations. For others I haven't completely checked if they could be removed
3. There are still comments containing the regex ``python2|python 2|PY2|PY 2`` (52 instances total). The related code should be looked through for simplifications. Likewise the similar regex for Python3.
4. The issue tracker currently has 24 [py2/3 compat issues](https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%222%2F3+Compat%22). Some of these can be closed now, while other can be seen as notes that some patterns are possible now that python2 support has been dropped.

Else I don't see much systematic, but in a code base of this size, there is bound to be fragments here and there that people will just have to remove upon encountering them.

Resolution of points 3 and 4 require some effort as most of the issues are quite specific. Going through and closing those could perhaps be the subject of an online sprint?

BTW, I don't necessarily see the above as blockers for a 0.25 release, but more like "things that should be cleaned up in order to have a tidy and modern code base". And doing them while there is a focus on python2/3 compat will probably be better than doing it "later".
this is not blocking 0.25; just seeing if we can close it :)
Since it is not blocking, moving this from the 0.25 milestone

sure

i don’t think we have anything concrete left that we want to remove

review_comments: we might not even need to define str and unicode here and in base.py (future PR)
